content: Asas Dhube Gidopa
Yesuusi ba tamaaretako, “Ase dhubethidi nagaran gelsiyabay yoonna aggenna. Gidoshin, nagaran gelana mela oothiya ura ayye!” yaagis.
He uray kaalotape issuwa balethanaape woxa ba qoodhen qachidi abban wulliko iyaw lo77o.
Hessa gisho naagetite. “Ne ishay nagara oothiko hanqeta; qiirotidi maarotethan simmiko, iyaw atto yaaga.
Issi gallasan laapun toho qohidi, laapun toho, ‘Taani ta nagaraa eras tana maara’ yaagidi neeko yiiko iyaw atto ga.”
Hawaareti Godaako, “Ammano nuus gujarki” yaagidosona.
Goday, “Gaashe ayfe mela ammanoy hintew de7iko ‘Haysa wolaa shodetada abba giddon toketa’ yaagiko hintew kiitetana” yaagis.
Gujidika Yesuusi, “Hinte giddofe issuwas goshshanchoy woyko dorse heemmiya aylley de7iko ooso gadepe woyko wudepe soo simmiya wode, ‘Elle haayada kathi maanaw utta’ yaagey de7ii?
Deenna, ‘Taw kaho giigisa; taani mada, uyada aggana gakanaw eqada muza. Hessafe guye, neeni qassi maasanne uyaasa’ yaageneyee?
Hiza, goday, aylley kiita polida gisho anjiyee?
Hessa gisho, hinteka kiitetoysa ubbaa polida wode, ‘Nu pathonna aylleta; oothanaw bessiya oosuwa polida’ yaagite” yaagis.
Baro Hargefe Geeyda Tammu Asata
Yesuusi Yerusalaame bishe Samaarisinne Galilas giddora kanthidi aadhis.
Issi gutaa geliya wode baro hargen oyketida tammu asati iya demmidosona. Entika haahon eqidi,
“Godaa Yesuusa, nuus qadhetarki” yaagidi waassidosona.
I enta be7ida wode, “Bidi hintenatethaa Ayhude kahine bessite” yaagis. Enti ogiya bolla bishe paxidosona.
Entafe issoy ba paxuwa be7ida wode dhoqu gida qaalan Xoossa bonchishe Yesuusako simmis.
I, Samaare biitta asi, shin Yesuusa toho bolla gufannidi iya galatis.
Yesuusi, “Paxiday tammu asata gidokonaayee? Yaatin, uddufunati aw bidonaa?
Ha allaga uraape
attishin, hari simmidi Xoossa galatey deenna guusseyee?” yaagidi oychis.
Uraako, “Ne ammanoy nena pathis; dendada ba” yaagis.
Xoossa Kawotetha Yuussaa
Farsaaweti, “Xoossa kawotethay awude yaanee?” gidi Yesuusa oychidosona. I, “Xoossaa kawotethay bentiya mallan yeenna.
Qassika iya, ‘Hannina woyko hinina yaaganaw danda7enna. Ayis giiko, Xoossa kawotethay hinte giddon de7ees’ ” yaagidi zaaris.
Yesuusi ba tamaaretako, “Asa Na7a gallasatape issuwa be7anaw hinte amotiya wodey yaana, shin hinte be7eketa.
Asay, ‘I yan de7ees’ woyko, ‘Haysan de7ees’ yaagana, shin entana kaallidi boopite.
Wol7anthi wol7amidi salo gaxape gaxa poo7isiya mela Asa Na7aa yuussaa gallasay hessada hanana.
Shin hessi hananaape sinthe Asa Na7ay daro waayanawunne ha yeletethan ixetanaw bessees.
Nohe wode hanidaysa mela Asa Na7a woden hessada hanana.
Nohey Markabiyan gelida qamma gakanaw asay mishenne uyishe, ekishenne gelishe de7ishin dhayo haathay yidi ubbaa dhaysis.
Looxe laythanka hessatho hanis. Asay mishenne uyishe, shammishenne bayzishe, tokishenne keexishe, gam7idosona.
Looxey Soodomepe keyida gallas diinne geetetiya xuuggiyabay salope bukidi ubbaa dhaysis.
Asa Na7ay qonciya wodeka hessada hanana.
“He gallasan karen de7iya oonika keetha giddon de7iyaba ekanaw soo gelopo. Hessadaka, gaden de7iya asi aykoska soo simmofo.
Looxe machiw akeekite;
ba shempiw ashshanaw koyiya asi oonika dhaysana; ba shempiw aathidi immiya oonika I ashshana.
Ta hintew odayis; he gallasan nam7u asati issi arsan zin7ana; issoy eketana, hankoy attana.
Nam7u maccasati wolla gaaccishin iissiya eketana, hankiya attana.
Nam7u asati wolla gaden goyeysatape issoy eketana, hankoy attana”
yaagis.
Enti, “Godaw aw eketanee?” yaagidi oychidosona. I, “Bawuti de7iya bessan ankoti shiiqoosona” yaagis.

footnotes.text: Ha allaga uraape: Baro hargiyafe paxida uray allaga geetetiday I Ayhude gidonna gishosa.
